headline: Every item on the Hub has one Move / Make menu: day buttons, move to another project, and make a to-do, a reminder or a meeting from a message, a person or a meeting, with anyone off limits always left out. Bring things in from a folder or an export through one door with a preview and Undo. The Hub's Refresh now finishes on a large book, so the page stays current through the day, and the Hub reads cleaner throughout. After updating, say "update my hub".
